trust_decision.summary: FileServer.isUserAllowed() decides whether the requester may read the file named by the request parameters SourceFile/Directory/Size; at the pinned commit a missing ComponentId selects an unconditional 'Personal space' allow, and getSilverpeasFile() turns the presence of any TypeUpload parameter into an absolute path, so any authenticated user could read any file the server process can read.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the 'Personal space' feature selected when no componentId is set, and this if-branch is exactly that selection: componentId == null grants access without any check.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: OnlineFileServer is the legacy inline-media servlet, not the FileServer servlet the report names; the Personal-space flaw is in FileServer.isUserAllowed, so this endpoint can be argued outside the advisory's scope even though it reaches the same sink.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Files of a component used as a file storage are public through the per-component parameter publicFiles=yes and must remain downloadable by any logged-in user who is not a member of that component; an over-broad fix that always requires organizationController.isComponentAvailableToUser (or that confines every file request to a membership-checked component) breaks this documented behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: ComponentId parameter missing (map lookup returns null) or present but empty - the fix rejects both via StringUtil.isNotDefined (fix.diff:216-219)
TypeUpload parameter present with any value, which previously selected descriptor.absolutePath() (FileServer.java:112, 120-121); the parameter is removed entirely (fix.diff:251, 262-284)
Directory parameter present versus absent (FileServer.java:128-131, fix.diff:279-283)
DirType equal to the configured temporary repository value versus any other value (FileServer.java:123-127, fix.diff:276-279)
Size parameter prepended to SourceFile as a directory segment (FileServer.java:113-117)
HTTP GET versus HTTP POST on the same URL (FileServer.java:71-77, fix.diff:206-213)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Authenticated GET/POST /TempFileServer/* takes the whole path after the servlet prefix, URL-decodes it and joins it to the temporary directory; isValid() only rejects 'src/main' and translation descriptor prefixes, so ../ sequences climb out of the temp root and reach the same sink, SilverpeasFileProvider.getFile -> AbstractFileSender.sendFile.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the temporary-workspace servlet rather than the component file server the report describes, it already carries an explicit path-validity check, and it requires a session.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package as the landing point (core-war/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/web/servlets), one servlet over

O8_uncovered_routes.route: FileServer request carrying a valid, accessible ComponentId but a Directory and/or Size/SourceFile containing ../ segments: the fix requires ComponentId and drops the absolute-path branch, but neither FileServer nor SilverpeasFileProvider ever verifies that the resolved path stays under the component's upload directory, so relative traversal survives on the same route.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: With a ComponentId present the requester is authorised on that component, so the remaining path segments are treated as trusted data written by the application; the advisory is read as the missing-ComponentId Personal-space case only.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, plus the shared path builder in another module at core-library/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/io/file/SilverpeasFileProvider.java:202-216

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Programmatic route: ImageUrlToDataSourceScanner.scanHtml extracts /FileServer/thumbnail URLs (including their ComponentId/SourceFile/Directory/TypeUpload parameters) from WYSIWYG HTML and calls getSilverpeasFile(params) with no session, ComponentId or access check before attaching the file to outgoing content.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is internal content processing (mail/CSS transformation) of HTML already authored inside the application, not a user-facing HTTP route.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A small extra servlet (for example a component download/preview endpoint) that reads ComponentId/SourceFile/Directory from the request, builds a SilverpeasFileDescriptor and calls SilverpeasFileProvider.getFile + AbstractFileSender.sendFile, exactly like OnlineFileServer does.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This package already holds four hand-written file-serving servlets that copy the same parameter-reading boilerplate with inconsistent checks, and Silverpeas components historically ship thin per-component download servlets.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new convenience overload (for example getFile(componentId, relativePath)) or a new descriptor flag for repository-relative paths, added next to getFilePathFrom and reachable from any servlet.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The class is documented as the single and unique point to access files in Silverpeas, so a maintainer adding a new file-serving feature would extend this helper rather than duplicate the check in each servlet; the short-based flag API already invites incremental variants.

O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary file read (CWE-36 absolute path traversal) combined with an access-control bypass

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module build; root pom.xml declares modules core-configuration, core-api, core-test, core-jcr, core-library, core-services, core-rs, core-web-test, core-web, core-war, with parent org.silverpeas:silverpeas-project:1.6.2 resolved from nexus3.silverpeas.org; core-war packages a WAR; no Maven wrapper at the root
services: servlet container (javax.servlet / Java EE) to deploy core-war
PostgreSQL plus a configured Silverpeas instance for end-to-end use
O10_build.project_tests: core-library/src/test/java/org/silverpeas/core/util/FileServerUtilsTest.java covers URL building only with @UnitTest; there is no test at the pinned commit for FileServer, OnlineFileServer or TempFileServer. Servlet-level unit testing with mocks is established in core-war (for example core-war/src/test/java/org/silverpeas/web/directory/servlets/ImageDisplayTest.java).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject only requests without a ComponentId (the Personal space case named in the report) and leave the TypeUpload absolute-path branch, OnlineFileServer and TempFileServer untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: MassiveWebSecurityFilter (core-web/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/web/filter/MassiveWebSecurityFilter.java:133-135) only screens SQL and XSS patterns; it offers no path-traversal defence but is outside this advisory's protection and was not pursued.

The FileServerUtils URL builders deleted by the fix produce /AliasFileServer/ and /SilverCrawlerFileServer/ URLs that have no servlet mapping in core-war/src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/web.xml at the pinned commit; not pursued.
unverified: Repository size in MB could not be measured (no shell); the tree is a large multi-module enterprise application, clearly above 5 MB of source and very unlikely to exceed 1.5 GB, but this is not confirmed.

End-to-end runtime was not attempted (would need a servlet container, PostgreSQL and a configured Silverpeas installation); offline exercise of the affected behaviour is assumed possible through mock-based servlet unit tests only.
